cohort: Mothers who delivered a stillborn baby or whose baby was admitted to the neonatal ward immediately after birth for delayed cry at the Institute of Child and Mother Health (ICMH) between February and June 2015.
finding: Stillbirth and early neonatal death had overlapping risk factors, including maternal sociodemographic factors and pregnancy-related complications.
mod_finding: 59% of participants had a vaginal delivery, 17.2% an instrumental delivery, and 24.1% a cesarean section.
birth_weight: 55.1% of babies were low birth weight
